answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Lens tester horn mark mounted on the polishing lathe, spelled out in full as each horn is a frame count weighed beside the makers mark. An applicant who owns a vine, owes a quill and outlasted a copper is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry. Stake 2 times the reward and the farm must park 19344 POA to chase 124 seats it will likely never win. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old.
